column1: # Per-host roll-up of the 378-deletion screen at n = 22, extracted 2026-10-07
# from the cluster results tree in ONE pass over results/*/done/b*.
# Totals, checked against the 2026-09-25 reading before anything was read off
# it: hosts 378, blocks 1890, tried 18900, exhausted 13863, capped 5037.
# capped_frac = capped / tried.  LOW MEANS CHEAP TO EXHAUST, which is the
# quantity a complete uncapped cover is priced on -- not a measure of how
# likely the host is to be an obstruction.  Every one of the 378 is equally
# witness-free; this orders them by what a full sweep would COST.
# Each host was sampled 50 base states of 8,031 from random.Random(host),
# so a proportion here carries a standard error of about 0.065 and
# TAB: host, blocks, tried, exhausted, capped, capped_frac
